findings.title: Concurrent cache misses are serialized but not coalesced
findings.body: After a caller observes a nil cache under the read lock, it acquires the write lock and unconditionally reloads the manifest. Every other concurrent non-Dev caller that observed nil before the first caller populated the cache will wait for the lock and then also perform its own file/CDN read while holding the write lock. During startup or after an initial failed load, this makes N concurrent requests execute N sequential manifest loads and delays all of them. Recheck `entryPointAssetsCache` after acquiring the write lock (for non-Dev configurations) and return the populated value if another caller filled it.
